item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a grounded love story, a gonzo crime thriller and a gaming triumph
item.description: An inspired synthesis of violent satire and contemplative storytelling, Grand Theft Auto VI is more mature and ambitious than any prior game in the record-breaking franchise.

item.title: Greetings from a Berlin square, where an artist's statue watches over children at play
item.description: Children frolic around the ever-watchful and calm Käthe Kollwitz cast in bronze, in a square named after the German artist, whose work often depicted children in the wake of World War I.

item.title: How the East Potomac golf course became a D.C. landmark — and what could happen to it
item.description: A federal judge is keeping East Potomac Park open for now, but hasn't ordered the government to keep the municipal golf course operational.

item.title: Why an SNL comedy sketch about caretaking went viral
item.description: The SNL ad parody "Sister" hit home for daughters caring for parents without help from their brothers. NPR's Juana Summers speaks with writer Liz Plank about her Substack essay on why it resonated.

item.title: Friends reconnect through YouTube reaction videos
item.description: Two friends reconnect through their love of music. One of them suffered a head trauma that affected his memory. So he's hearing every song for the first time all over again. And it's all on YouTube.

item.title: Take a look, it's in his book: LeVar Burton writes a memoir
item.description: The longtime host of Reading Rainbow is telling his own story. Burton opened a window to the past in Roots and helped imagine a different future on Star Trek. His new memoir is Take My Word for It.

item.title: A family runs afoul of the Russian mob in the terrific 'Paper Tiger'
item.description: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller star in a film that isn't merely one of this year's very best films; it possesses a weight and depth you rarely find in American movies anymore.

item.title: Nearly two million people are behind bars in the US. How did we get here?
item.description:
Lynn Novick's new, four-part PBS documentary series, Crime and Punishment in America, goes inside the U.S. prison system and explores how
our approach to criminals has changed over time.

item.title: Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond
item.description: "We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007," Denis Villeneuve, who will direct the new Bond film, said in an announcement from Amazon MGM Studios.
